_comment: Billable products. source: metering (SDL metering datasource report, the default) | inventory (daily snapshot of the asset inventory, GET /xdr/assets, filtered by active protection). Add a report here — no code change needed. rollup: peak | average | month_end | sum (month). daily: sum | max — how several rows of one scope on one day combine (seat counts are daily snapshots → max; default sum). breakdown: a report column to offer as a secondary dimension (or null). subtract: reports whose same-day, same-site counts are taken off this product (the metering endpoint reports count every agent by bundle, whatever protects it; the inventory says which ones are CWS). group: label used to cluster the chips in the UI.

products.label: Cloud Native Security
products.note: S1 already reports an average number of workloads per day.

products.label: Endpoint – Workstations
products.note: Daily snapshot of installed, not-decommissioned workstation agents, by bundle (Control / Complete).

products.label: Endpoint – Servers
products.note: Daily snapshot of server-OS agents by bundle (Control / Complete), minus the agents the inventory shows as CWS-protected on that day. Days before the first inventory snapshot are not split.

products.label: CWS – Servers
products.note: Daily snapshot of the asset inventory: server assets (VMs, physical servers) whose active protection is CWS.

products.label: CWS – Container hosts
products.note: Daily snapshot of the asset inventory: container hosts (Kubernetes nodes, Docker hosts) whose active protection is CWS.

products.label: CWS – Serverless containers
products.note: Max concurrently connected agents per day.

products.label: Data Ingest
products.note: Third-party data ingested; summed over the month and shown in GB/TB (average = mean bytes per day, peak = busiest day).

products.label: Identity – IDR
products.note: Max deployed, not-decommissioned agents per day.

products.label: Identity – ISPM / ISIDP
products.note: Snapshot of active on-prem AD users.

products.label: Prompt – Employees
products.note: Distinct active employees with the browser extension per day (daily seat count) — never summed across days; peak day of the period.

products.label: Prompt – AI Code Assistants
products.note: Distinct developers with the agent per day (daily seat count) — never summed across days; peak day of the period.

products.label: Prompt – Homegrown Apps
products.note: API calls made by homegrown apps; usage count summed over the billing period.

products.label: Prompt – Agentic AI
products.note: Agentic events; usage count summed over the billing period.

products.label: Prompt – AI Red Teaming
products.note: Executed attacks; usage count summed over the billing period.
